about: The executeSync passes and the scopes of the TypeScript sync code. Generated by scripts/sync-fixtures/record-execute-fixtures.test.ts (not in this repository). Edited by hand, so it differs from the recording: a pass does not upload this device's own day again when it is unchanged since its last upload (the Rust code records each upload in day_uploads of sync_state.json; the TypeScript code uploaded the day on every pass). The update requests of those uploads are removed, the Drive times of the day files are the ones of their first upload, and the sync_state.json left behind holds the day_uploads entry of the upload.
